llm.summary: This PA coordination skill is mostly coherent, but it handles sensitive contacts and owner email/calendar actions with weak scoping and includes an unsafe local config-loading command.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads and writes personal/business contact records and uses owner Gmail/calendar tooling; those powers are related to the use case but under-scoped for a general coordination skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown and JSON examples, but its runtime setup tells the agent to source an external .context file as shell code, which is an unsafe way to load configuration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are broad, including cross-PA work, broadcasts, directory creation/updates, memory logging, and calendar creation; email sending requires owner confirmation, but calendar creation and directory writes lack similarly clear approval and data-handling gates.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It persists contact data to disk, instructs logging issues in memory files, and suggests adding Gmail auth on error; no service or backdoor persistence was found, but the persistent data and account access need explicit user control.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated PA coordination purpose fits contact lookup, scheduling, and messaging, but the artifacts also authorize owner-account calendar creation, email sending, contact directory mutation, and use of an external primary contact list with incomplete boundaries.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Require explicit approval before any directory write, calendar creation, email send, broadcast, or auth setup; replace shell sourcing with strict config parsing; align the declared contact source; and remove real-looking example contact details.
llm.findings:
[T09] unexpected: Verified: artifact/SKILL.md instructs sourcing /opt/ocana/openclaw/workspace/skills/ai-pa/.context. Loading local configuration is purpose-aligned, but executing it as shell code is not proportionate.
[other] unexpected: Verified: artifact/ai-pa/pa-directory.example.json contains real-looking names, phone numbers, role, and corporate email data. Example contact data should be clearly synthetic.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Verified: artifact/SKILL.md declares data/pa-directory.json in the manifest but later says PA_LIST.md is the primary source, creating unclear provenance for sensitive contact records.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Verified: the skill provides scripts to create and update contact directories containing names, phones, owners, roles, and emails without explicit approval, minimization, or audit guidance.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Verified: calendar creation is presented as a normal scheduling step and may modify an owner calendar or notify attendees, but the top-level schedule flow does not require a final confirmation.
[SDI-2] expected: Verified: owner-email sending is related to PA coordination and includes an owner-confirmation instruction, but it remains high-impact and should be narrowly gated.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Verified: the nested ai-pa/SKILL.md invocation text includes any cross-PA task, which is broad for a skill that can drive messaging, contact edits, and account actions.
